scope: Seven actor modules compared to e548493; current simulation, audio, grass and ColonyRenderer shared. Prepared 32x32 scene in pause. Ordinary CPU/RAF and timestamp GPU runs executed successively; not a full-map or whole-game before/after proof.

reports.protocol: Each phase reloads the identical raw save, fixes camera pose and toggles, warms up, then measures for a fixed wall-time window. Native Chromium/WebGPU, 1920x1080, DPR 1. RAF is display paced; frame CPU includes JS and render submission, not GPU execution. Worker stepMs is simulation time per tick reported in snapshots, not total worker cost. GPU timestamps require a separate instrumented run. Three draw/triangle counters can omit retained bundle replay.
